manifest_commit_note: This manifest cannot contain its own commit or hash. A verifier must recompute self_hash after removing the self_hash field.
nature: Assessment-only. Readiness classification of frozen owner decisions against the frozen Gate 0 criteria. No candidate, no experiment, no data processing, no audit, no gate pass.
no_performance_claim: This manifest records a documentary readiness assessment. It contains no P&L, return, expectancy, win rate, drawdown, Sharpe, Sortino, CAGR, equity curve, bootstrap, Monte Carlo, optimisation, backtest, paper-trade or live-trade result. No market-data row was processed, no venue was contacted, no audit was performed, and no gate was passed. The frequency and notional-cap comparisons are arithmetic consequences of recorded owner values, not evidence about any candidate.

owner_values_restated_not_changed.label: owner-selected limits; not empirically verified execution characteristics

repository.artifact_commit_note: The four Stage 2P documents were committed and pushed in one-document increments, followed by two corrective edits to the row tally and the notional-cap thresholds, before this manifest. HEAD at manifest update is the final document commit; the final HEAD is the commit that introduces this file. The manifest cannot contain its own commit or hash.
